skill.name: youtube-influencer-finder-api-skill
skill.description: Find YouTube creators by keyword and upload date through BrowserAct, returning channel metrics, social links, and available contact details.

skill.author: browser-act

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives from Markdown formatting, ordinary secret-variable names, fixed service URLs, and task identifiers. Confirmed behavior includes BrowserAct requests, local script execution, credential solicitation, and creator contact-data collection.

remediation.issue: The instructions encourage users to provide an API key directly to the agent.
remediation.suggestion: Require BROWSERACT_API_KEY through an environment variable or secret manager, and never request credentials in conversation.

remediation.issue: The skill sends search terms and authentication data to BrowserAct.
remediation.suggestion: Disclose the external transfer and obtain user confirmation before starting each BrowserAct workflow.

remediation.issue: The documented command can include user-provided search keywords.
remediation.suggestion: Launch the script with a direct argument array and validate input values instead of interpolating text into a shell command.

remediation.issue: Creator emails and social links can be collected for outreach.
remediation.suggestion: Add consent, privacy, retention, and acceptable-use guidance for contact data and comply with platform terms.

content.value_statement: Finding suitable YouTube creators requires slow, repetitive profile research. This skill runs a BrowserAct workflow and returns channel metrics, links, and available contact details.
actual_capabilities: Searches YouTube creator profiles by a supplied keyword.
Filters results by Today, This Week, This Month, or This Year.
Starts a predefined BrowserAct workflow and polls its status for up to five minutes.
Returns channel views, video counts, subscriber counts, registration dates, and countries when available.
Returns channel links, profile descriptions, social links, and available contact emails.
Reports connection, authorization, task failure, and timeout conditions.
limitations: Requires Python, the requests package, network access, and a valid BrowserAct API key.
Depends on BrowserAct and YouTube availability, coverage, and current platform behavior.
A workflow can take several minutes and times out after five minutes.
Contact details may be missing, outdated, or subject to privacy and platform restrictions.

prompt_templates.title: Find Creators
prompt_templates.prompt: Find YouTube creators for [keyword] who uploaded this month. Show channel name, subscribers, total views, and channel link.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner search for a current creator list

prompt_templates.title: Find Recently Active Creators
prompt_templates.prompt: Search for [keyword] creators active this week. Return profiles with social links and note missing contact details.
prompt_templates.scenario: Focused research using a recent upload filter

prompt_templates.title: Compare Two Niches
prompt_templates.prompt: Run separate searches for [keyword A] and [keyword B] using This Month. Compare subscriber counts, total views, and recent activity.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate comparison across two creator segments

prompt_templates.title: Build an Outreach Research Table
prompt_templates.prompt: Find [keyword] creators active this year. Deduplicate profiles and organize metrics, channel links, social links, and available business contacts.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced preparation for compliant partnership research

output: Sample Creator A: 125,000 subscribers and 8.4 million total views.

output_examples.output: The BrowserAct task could not start because authorization failed. Update BROWSERACT_API_KEY securely before running the search again.

best_practices: Confirm the keyword and upload-date filter before starting the external workflow.
Store BROWSERACT_API_KEY in an environment variable or secret manager, never in conversation.
Verify returned contact data and follow privacy, platform, and outreach requirements.
anti_patterns: Do not paste API keys into prompts, logs, source files, or command history.
Do not treat missing or outdated profile fields as verified facts.
Do not collect or use contact data for unsolicited bulk messaging.

faq.question: What credentials does this skill require?
faq.answer: It requires a valid BrowserAct API key stored as BROWSERACT_API_KEY.

faq.question: Which upload-date filters are supported?
faq.answer: The workflow supports Today, This Week, This Month, and This Year.

faq.question: How long can a search take?
faq.answer: The script polls for up to five minutes and reports status every ten seconds.

faq.question: Which creator fields can it return?
faq.answer: It can return channel metrics, country, description, channel URL, social links, and available contact email.

faq.question: Does every result include contact details?
faq.answer: No. Contact details depend on public availability and BrowserAct extraction results.

faq.question: Does it contact creators automatically?
faq.answer: No. It collects research data only and does not send outreach messages.
